notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.19.599
notes.notes:
[p]- Fixed bug that prevented 'Gloomfang' challenge from being completed under specific conditions
- 'W' + 'S' keys on the keyboard can now be used to control the power of flicks
- 'Q' and 'LeftShift' keys can now be used to swap heroes (in addition to 'TAB' and 'Mouse 4' button) ([i]Note: All new keybinds will be added to and displayed in the 'How To Play' menu in an upcoming update, stay tuned![/i])[/p]

notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.17.814
notes.notes:
- 'Rubber Bullets+' upgrade now correctly adds 2 bullet bounces
- Fixed rare bug where Huntress could shoot even though she was not currently selected
- Fixed infinite loop triggered by Klabautermann and 'Retaliation Strikes' + specific Bombs upgrades
- Added backups to save system to avoid data loss on system crashes
- Rerolling upgrades now guarantees a completely different set of new upgrades
- Fixed rare bug where player could get stuck in Scorching Summit boss arena after defeating the boss
- Fixed bug where finishing two 'Gloomfang' challenges in the same arena only resulted in one level up
- Some streamlining of enemy attack indicators: All orange indicators now signify that the attack can be interrupted by attacking the enemy

notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.14.697
notes.notes:
- Fixed Deep Frost+ only giving one extra stack instead of two
- Foes with 0HP can no longer get healed by 'Healing Factor' curse
- Death effects now trigger before Klabautermann uses his Jump Attacks, so he cannot be hit by them anymore.
- Foes with 0HP will no longer act during their turn
- Lightning can no longer affect friendly characters
- Lightning can no longer re-afflict disks while still resolving lightning strikes
- Heavy Purse: increased needed gold amount from 10 to 15 to bring it in line with other trinket damage bonuses
- Resolved a rare bug where the pause menu could no longer be opened until game restart
- Fixed a rare bug where the run finish screen would not open and the game would hang on a black screen forever

notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.07.760
notes.notes: [p]- Bile now spreads more slowly on doom level 1 and 2[/p][p]- Bile base damage is now reduced to 400[/p][p]- Hero Rocket Master no longer targets defeated or immune foes[/p][p]- 'Adrenaline Pump' curse -> flick is now easier to aim and fine-adjust[/p]

notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.05.769
notes.notes:
- Stopped "Pale Affliction" curse and "Hole-Riddled Bomb Pouch" curse from triggering after arena was won
- Fixed bug where sometimes bile would trigger without visuals
- Re-Added missing item variant to huntress item list
- Froggomancer does not tag immune enemies anymore
- Junk flinger does not hit immune enemies anymore
- Fine-adjust flick direction can now be controlled with A and D keys (update to 'how to play' section in pause menu is coming in one of the next patches)
- Fixed softlock with bombs
- Fixed error where some people who previously played the demo could not access their save files
- Set Nitro-Lizard explosion damage from 400 to 200
- Fixed issue where block frogs would not work correctly with multi attacks

notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.03.987 [Hotfix]
notes.notes: - Fixed bug that caused softlock when playing Huntress + Bombs and choosing 'Insta-Bombs' upgrade

notes.title: Patchnotes for version 1.00.03.923 [Hotfix]
notes.notes: - Changes to profile loading system to fix a bug that could cause save files to become inaccessible if demo was played months ago

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.07.14.717
notes.notes: [p]Hey! We've just released a new demo patch, just in time for Tiny Teams![/p][p]Aside from the usual such as smaller bugfixes, UI improvements and visual tweaks, this update actually comes with two big changes (that were inspired by community feedback):[/p][p][/p][h3]1) Relics are now chosen before starting a run[/h3][p]Here's the thing about [b]relics[/b]: They're really just [i]subclasses[/i] that you can freely assign to any hero - and this allows for lots of fun combinations and synergies when you build your [i]ultimate pirate tag team[/i].[/p][p]Up until now, it was difficult for new players to really get the difference between a trinket, a relic, a curse - so we've reworked a few parts of the game to streamline the whole process of starting a new run and emphasize the way relics and heroes interact.[/p][p]How does this look in practice? Well, here's the new character selection screen:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095455/53b85a9276a04f663595f2f8dca830d7a45e0ce0.png"][/img][i](Notice the [b]custom disks[/b] the characters are now standing on - those change depending on the relic you've assigned to the specific hero - pretty neat, right?)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that this will help communicate better what we're aiming for gameplay-wise for our game - let us know what you think![/p][h3][/h3][h3]2) Reworked fine-adjustment tutorial[/h3][p]We also noticed that staggering amount of players don't use the [b]fine-adjustment features built-in into the game. [/b][/p][p]You've heard correctly - you can actually [b]fine-adjust your flick with pinpoint accuracy[/b]! Always could, in fact! Which is especially useful in the later stages of the game, when a wrong flick can actually end your run![/p][p]Of course, it's really our fault for not conveying this better to players - which is why we've reworked our tutorial to better illustrate how to actually fine-adjust your flicks - we hope this will take your trick shots to the next level![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095455/4ea926364ed6878ab69c3c5479d45bbc978a14cc.png"][/img][i](A screenshot from the new fine-adjust tutorial!)[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p]Anyway, that's it for now. As always, please let us know if you find any bugs and give us your feedback if you find the time![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.07.03.677
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, new patch (v0.07.03.677) coming through![/p][p]This time, it's all about balancing and tweaking the demo's difficulty - we won't bore you with all the details, but here's the general direction of changes:[/p][list][*][p]Increases of enemy HP (in general)[/p][/*][*][p]Tougher and more challenging enemy groups, especially in the jungle biome[/p][/*][*][p]Some adjustments to trinkets that boost damage ('Vital Organs' being a good example), to prevent players from getting overpowered too quickly when stacking trinkets[/p][/*][/list][p]The result of this should be more challenging gameplay, where planning each flick carefully makes a real difference![/p][p]As always, please let us know your feedback after you've given the demo a go![/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.06.99.413
notes.notes: [p][i](Small Update: We've just updated the demo to version [b]0.06.99.383[/b] to fix a bug that could break the game when visiting a 'Cursed Idol' on doom level 1 - for anyone wondering why the version numbers in their game don't match exactly.)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]New demo patch coming through! Some new features, but mostly a lot of bug fixes![/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]The beach biome now has a 2nd battle theme, which is played at 'Sentinel Sands' - give it a listen![/p][/*][*][p]A 'hide menu' button has been implemented in story encounter screens and upgrade screens - for all of you who want to take a quick peek at upcoming encounters on the map while Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]Rephrasing of several item description for more clarity[/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements to relic selection screen and level up screen[/p][/*][/list][h2]Minor bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed bug that caused disk animations to spiral out of control when using specific item combinations[/p][/*][*][p]'Squid Captain' now spawns small crabs instead of upgraded small crabs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug that caused incorrect flick preview when opening and closing pause menu during flick[/p][/*][*][p]'Squid Armorer' now updates its current target line even after teleporting away[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that causes the 'flick compass' to "flicker" at very specific angles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes a bug that caused music to stop playing after a very specific collision event[/p][/*][*][p]Changed a few text settings to prevent overflow in weapon sheet description texts[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players sometimes received multiple rewards in encounters[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese/Japanese/Korean text is no longer italicized[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where quitting the run in level up screen would break the game[/p][/*][*][p]Minor formatting fixes for languages other than English[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where in certain situations, items would show wrong damage numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some item-specific issues with saving and reloading[/p][/*][*][p]Channeling Power: Fireflies are now correctly kept if collecting them after dealing damage[/p][/*][*][p]Some infinite loops with the 'Retaliation Strike' upgrade of the Klabautermann are now fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer get softlocked when clicking through screens too fast[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue where sometimes the mouse cursor could be broken[/p][/*][*][p]'Demotivating Start' curse now triggers and deals damage at the correct time[/p][/*][*][p]Game now runs in background as default[/p][/*][*][p]... and a lot more smaller fixes![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That's it! And as is tradition - a big thanks to everyone who has helped us improve the game by submitting bug reports and sharing feedback! [/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.06.68.674
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]New demo patch coming through - and a fairly big one at that! [/p][p][/p][h2]UI[/h2][list][*][p]There's a new option in the settings called "[b]Show Enemy HP Numbers[/b]" - enabling this will display the current healthpoints of all enemies on screen![/p][/*][*][p]Support for more screen ratios than just regular old 16:9 - everything from [b]20:9[/b] (for all widescreen enthusiasts) [b]to 4:3[/b] (how retro!) should now work correctly![/p][/*][*][p]Lots of little UI tweaks - reworked icons, color adjustments, and much more![/p][/*][/list][h2]Balancing[/h2][p]We've been collecting all your feedback from the last few weeks and are in the process of adjusting the game's balance!
One thing we quickly noticed was just how [i]good players are actually at beating the demo [/i]- it seems like we've [b]underestimated[/b] all of you! [/p][p]As a result, the overarching theme here is going to be:
[b][i]"More Challenge to Sink Your Teeth Into!"[/i][/b][/p][p]
And we're just getting started with the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]The first miniboss (the humble [i]'Bomb Crab'[/i]) now calls in reinforcements after its first phase.[/p][/*][*][p]On top of that, [b]destroying its bombs will now cause them to explode[/b] - better plan ahead when flicking into them![/p][/*][*][p]All combat encounters in the jungle will now feature harder and more challenging enemy groups.[/p][/*][*][p]The [i]'Engineer Apes'[/i] found in the jungle will now [b]spawn turrets every turn[/b] - and to make things even more interesting, the turrets themselves also deal more damage![/p][/*][*][p]The [i]'Cyborg Ape'[/i] miniboss now receives a [b]stronger boost from its minions[/b] - and you'll actually have to destroy minions to stop them from boosting![/p][/*][*][p]In general, a lot of [b]attacks from enemies[/b] across both beach and jungle biomes [b]now hit considerably harder[/b] - especially boss attacks![/p][/*][*][p]The [b]'Barbwire Bramble' relic[/b] has been slightly nerfed by lowering the number of thorns it attaches to enemies to 2 and preventing re-attaching thorns in the same turn to the same enemy - we hope this will equalize the damage of all relics a bit![/p][/*][/list][h2]Audio[/h2][list][*][p]The second enemy faction of the game (the dreadful [b]Ape Armada[/b]) now has all of their sound effects added and implemented: [i]Charging teslacoils, electrostatic rifles & energy cannons packing a powerful punch[/i]![/p][/*][*][p]2 new music tracks have been added: [b]A second jungle biome battle theme[/b] and a very epic [b]biome boss theme[/b]! [/p][/*][/list][h2]Localization[/h2][list][*][p]Adjustments, fixes and improvements to the following languages: Italian, Chinese (Simplified) and Portuguese![/p][/*][/list][h2]Minor bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Lots of little bug fixes for the UI & enemy behaviour![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, thanks to everyone reporting bugs and providing feedback! We still have a lot of additional balancing changes (and extra features) planned for another patch (coming shortly!), so this is only the beginning![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.06.42.771
notes.notes: [h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]Another small demo patch coming through![/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]We've added [b]highlights and audio feedback[/b] to some of the parts of the [b]"flickbow"[/b] ([i]the widget that appears when you start aiming your flick[/i]): A lot of players didn't realize they can actually fine-adjust both their flick direction and flick power, so we hope that this little change will communicate this better![/p][/*][*][p]Also, we now show the tutorial explaining the fine-adjust features a bit earlier in the run[/p][/*][/list][h2]Localization[/h2][list][*][p]Our localization team has been going over all the texts in the demo and polished translations all across the board![/p][/*][/list][h2]Audio[/h2][list][*][p]The jungle biome now has its own unique map theme - it's really catchy![/p][/*][/list][h2]Minor bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed some typos and formatting errors in some descriptions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, thanks to everyone reporting bugs and providing feedback! We do read everything that's posted on the Discord, in the demo reviews and all the feedback coming through email - and as soon as NextFest is over, we'll get right to implementing it![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.06.37.615
notes.notes: [h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]Another small demo patch coming through, this time some finishing touches for Steam Nextfest![/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]As you may already have noticed, the demo now comes with a language selector (found in the lower-right corner of the main menu) - let us know if you find any typos or formatting errors in any of the 10 new languages! For more information on this, check out this announcement: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2427450/view/511834275001141604?l=english"][/dynamiclink][/p][/*][*][p]We've also added a little "fingerprint" to the final run end screen - so we can verify whether a screenshot of the run stats is genuine. Why? Let's just say we have a little contest planned on our Discord for Nextfest... ([url="https://discord.com/invite/3eXyP9gF2u"]https://discord.com/invite/3eXyP9gF2u[/url])[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance[/h2][list][*][p]Firefly Booster -> Channeling Power: Collected fireflies now count against the spawn limit for fireflies[/p][/*][/list][h2]Major Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could not progress after Ape Boss encounter when using gamepad[/p][/*][/list][h2]Minor bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could not change the language after winning a run[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typos and formatting errors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And as always, a big thank you to our playtesters for taking the time to report bugs![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.06.03.674
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

We're back with another small patch, consisting of lots of little bugfixes, description text changes as well some UI improvements!

[h2]Text & Descriptions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Another round of description text rewrites to help players understand the various item effects better!
[*] Junk Trinkets should now correctly display the amount of junk you're currently holding
[*] Changes to fix of any remaining typos
[/list]
[h2]Audio & Video[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improvements to audio mixing to help balance out effects, ambience and music
[*] Fixes and improvements for the backgrounds in the jungle biome - now more lush than ever!
[/list]
[h2]UI/UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've finally got around to adding a few missing UI elements into our game, including new and improved banner and frame graphics for the Klabautermann and the Froggomancer!
[*] We've also added hover highlights and lots of audio feedback to all the different buttons you can click in the game - expect lots of little glowing outlines, clicks and taps as you move your mouse across the screen!
[/list]
And of course, there's also a lot of work being done on the full game at the same time - but that's a topic for the next development update!

Stay tuned and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes for v0.06.00.752
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

A big thank you to all the players who played our demo and provided us with lots of valuable feedback and bug reports over the weekend! We now have a nice list of things to fix, and we're already hard at work!

This patch is a smaller one, mostly consisting of changes to the in-game descriptions, some audio/visual polish, and of course, game balancing!
Here's a list for you to check out:

[h2]Text & Descriptions[/h2]
[list]
[*]We've rewritten and changed various descriptions, mostly upgrades but also some story encounter texts, based on your feedback!
[*]Especially the 'Sticky Bombs' relic and its upgrades should now be easier to understand (but a lot of the other weapons and relics received some improvements as well!).
[*]And as always, we've fixed smaller typos and formatting errors while we were at it. Let us know if you find more!
[/list]
[h2]Audio & Video[/h2]
[list]
[*] The 'bell' sound played when a disk is defeated is now harmonized with the music track playing in the background. Try to take a good listen the next time you vanquish a foe!
[*] The world map now more clearly shows which enemy faction inhabits the upcoming regions.
[*] Remember those pesky spike traps in the jungle that deviously blended into the environment? Well, they now shake and move ever so slightly to remind players to stay away from them (or maybe push an unlucky foe into them?).
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] We re-balanced the map layout of all encounter maps. More difficult paths should now feel more rewarding for those who dare to travel them!
[*] We've adjusted the overall shield players start with and gain with each level. Expect more of a challenge, especially on the higher doom level!
[*] Some of the more overpowered (and underpowered) relic upgrades have now been adjusted a bit to make them more balanced relative to each other.
[/list]
Of course, this is only the begining, and we've got many more improvements and fixes planned in the upcoming weeks! Stay tuned and keep the feedback coming – it's a huge help!

notes.title: Development Update #1 - Beach Biome
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Apologies for going dark for a few months. Been a hectic start to the year! Just to let you know our plan going forward is to keep some regular development updates going here maybe every couple weeks. This will be development news, festivals, events, demos and more! 

But also, tell us what you would like to see! Are there questions, features or news you want to know about? Ask away in the comments or on the forums. 

With that, we wanted to give you a sneak peek at the [b]Beach Biome[/b] and it's enemies. You can see most of these in action in the trailer, but we wanted to share a closer look at the level designs and character models. 

[h1]Beach Biome - Crabs and Squids[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095455/8f3c8a4b521c70c73fd733f59704fe285c9951c0.png[/img]

The first stop on your quest is sandy with some rocks, palm trees and water elements. And watch out! The beach is populated with a bunch of angry crustations. Although they are small and individually weak, crabs can multiply and out number you quickly. Stay sharp! (Pun intended)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095455/6d8c3b8f1a75e3c759e4cb38592402e0295d095d.png[/img]

This video also shows the Hyper Hermit in action. The Hyper Hermit is a sub boss who doesn't care who stands in their way. Friend or foe, if you're in the line of fire you better watch out! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095455/67bb7d7e2cd6a25afab5d2c5922f1699998bb548.gif[/img]

Hope your enjoyed this look and we can't wait to share more!
